title: Amazon Announces Inference Chips Deal With Cerebras
title_zh: 亚马逊宣布与 Cerebras 达成推理芯片交易
summary: Amazon Web Services plans to deploy processors designed by Cerebras inside its data centers, the latest vote of confidence in the startup, which specializes in chips that power artificial-intelligence models.
summary_zh: 亚马逊网络服务计划在其数据中心内部署 Cerebras 设计的处理器，这是对这家专门生产人工智能模型芯片的初创公司的最新信任票。

title: Does Goldman Sachs (GS) Offer Value After Recent Share Price Pullback?
title_zh: 高盛 (GS) 在近期股价回调后是否具有价值？
summary: If you are wondering whether Goldman Sachs Group's current share price lines up with its underlying worth, you are not alone. This article is here to unpack what the market might be pricing in.
summary_zh: 如果您想知道高盛集团当前的股价是否与其潜在价值相符，那么您并不孤单。本文旨在揭示市场可能定价的内容。

title: Ecuador trade deal: Trump administration targets lower food and tech levies
title_zh: 厄瓜多尔贸易协议：特朗普政府目标是降低食品和科技税
summary: Investing.com — U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer signed a finalized trade agreement with Ecuador on Friday, reducing tariffs across several industrial and agricultural sectors as the Trump administration continues to overhaul its Western Hemisphere trade strategy.
summary_zh: Investing.com——随着特朗普政府继续改革其西半球贸易战略，美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔周五与厄瓜多尔签署了最终贸易协议，降低了多个工业和农业部门的关税。

title: Is KKR’s (KKR) Deal Juggling Amid Liquidity Strains Reframing Its Private Markets Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 在流动性紧张的情况下进行的交易是否正在重新制定其私募市场策略？
summary: In recent days, KKR has reportedly joined the bidding for Pacific Equity Partners-owned UP Education, which could fetch more than A$1.00 billion, while also exploring a potential sale of liquid-cooling provider CoolIT Systems in a deal that may exceed US$3.00 billion.
summary_zh: 据报道，最近几天，KKR 加入了对 Pacific Equity Partners 旗下的 UP Education 的竞购，该交易的售价可能超过 10 亿澳元，同时还在探索出售液冷供应商 CoolIT Systems 的可能性，交易金额可能超过 30 亿美元。

title: Trump administration set to receive $10 billion ‘fee’ for brokering TikTok deal
title_zh: 特朗普政府将因 TikTok 交易收取 100 亿美元“费用”
summary: Investing.com — The Trump administration is poised to receive a roughly $10 billion "brokerage" fee from the investor group that recently took control of TikTok’s U.S. operations, according to a report by the Wall Street Journal.
summary_zh: Investing.com——据《华尔街日报》报道，特朗普政府准备从最近控制 TikTok 美国业务的投资集团那里获得约 100 亿美元的“经纪”费。
